currentFmReference.synthesis: Synthesize(midi, 1.8f, false), float casts reproduced; gain=1, no energy normalization

timeline.timingMethod: four-beat recurring onset energy; estimated, not a human-verified score
timeline.harmonyMethod: HPSS harmonic STFT chroma / major-minor triad similarity; estimated

selection.method: Parent-selected sustained mono RMS in middle third, 16-beat-aligned starts, 24-beat windows; score = 75% window RMS + 25% minimum four-beat bar RMS
selection.interpretation: Middle high-energy candidate, not a human-confirmed chorus

processing.cropBy: AuthoredScore beats in source samples; onset from saved eighths, no hardcoded BPM
processing.newTones: Unmodified shared tone(): energy .010 / peak cap .48; 1.2 seconds
